scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Plan with points at zero. Base the decision on yield you can measure.
Treat points as an airdrop bet
Hedge price if you only want the yield
scenes.vo: Restaking reuses staked assets to secure more services, paying extra rewards and often points: an off-chain score that may or may not become a token. The risk stack grows at each layer: staking to liquid restaking token to restaking protocol to each service it secures to slashing conditions. Professional rules: Plan with points at zero. Base the decision on yield you can measure. Treat points as an airdrop bet: EV = P(payout) times value minus costs. Hedge price if you only want the yield: short the underlying perp (strategy #24), knowing the hedge doesn't cover a depeg of the restaking token. Cap it: speculative bucket only (at most 5–10% of DeFi capital).
